texts.zh: 我们在气态巨行星[From.GetName]的上层大气中发现了一个生机勃勃的生态系统。巨大的漂浮生物已经进化出密度轻于空气的身体，可以随风而动，并从气态巨行星频繁的雷暴中摄取能源。这些生物也养活了浮游生物以及猎食浮游生物的小型动物，这些小型动物也互相为食。
texts.en: We have discovered a thriving ecosystem in the upper atmosphere of the gas giant [From.GetName]. Massive floating creatures, having evolved bodies filled with lighter than air gases, follow the wind currents and feed off the energy released by the gas giant's frequent lightning storms. These beings in turn support colonies of smaller animals that prey on atmospheric plankton and each other.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗气态巨行星的名称。
note.en: In the game, the gas giant's name appears here.

texts.zh:
我们确实在[From.GetName]上发现了生命，但也是因为我们的行动，这一生命已经灭绝了。这些微生生物住在气态巨行星的外层边缘，对于我们的深度扫描表现出了极大的负面反应。扫描的频率同生物的细胞结构产生了共振——这一效应如同瀑布倾泻而下般飞速传开，从一个气态小虫子传播到另一只气态小虫。所有生物都在收到影响之后不久就不再活动了。

我们现在正环绕着全宇宙最大的坟场。
texts.en:
We did indeed discover life on [From.GetName], but by our actions, it has since been eradicated. The microbial creatures which lived in the outer edges of the gas giant's atmosphere reacted poorly to our deep scans. These frequencies caused each creature's cellular structure to resonate - an effect that then cascaded and spread from gas mite to gas mite. Each was rendered inert soon after.

We are now in orbit over the largest graveyard in the universe.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 为错误赎罪是一项强权者的特权，在此情此景下，我们必须深切地赎罪。[From.GetName]上的灾难令人震愕，而我们唯一的愿望是我们的科学家们能够反转我们深层探测器的极性，寄希望于能以此重新点燃这颗气态巨行星内部的生命之火。
texts.en: Atoning for your mistakes is a privilege for those with power, and in this scenario, we must atone dearly. The disaster on [From.GetName] was horrifying, and our only hope is that our scientists can reverse the polarity of our deep scanners and potentially reignite the spark of life inside the gas giant.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗气态巨行星的名称。
note.en: In the game, this gas giant's name appears here.

texts.zh: 完成了！如同奇迹一般，当我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]对我们的飞船进行了合适的改造之后，它们能够重现最初的瀑布效应。这一次效果不一样，[FromFromFrom.GetName]上的生命体如同一波巨大的浪潮一样又重新涌动了起来。
texts.en: It is done! Miraculously, once our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] installed the proper modifications on our vessel, they were able to recreate the initial cascade. This time the effect was different, and life started springing back up all over [FromFromFrom.GetName] in a great wave.

texts.zh: 这一过程教会了我们许多关于宇宙的事情，但更多的可能是关于我们自己的事情。
texts.en: This process has taught us a lot about the universe but perhaps even more about ourselves.

summary.text:
# 生命迹象 / Life Signs

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration

## 如何开始 How it starts

没有战略资源的气态巨行星可能生成（2级，权重3，全局一次 max_once）。

Can spawn on a gas giant without a strategic resource (level 2, weight 3, once per game via max_once).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

两个结果各占50%。anomaly.300“大气层生态系统”：d_society_3 矿藏与 atmospheric_ecosystem 修正（并设置标志 atmoseco_divination_flag）。anomaly.6845“连锁灾难”：清除矿藏；不重视他人的帝国可直接获得社会研究加成；除非既不友善又排外，其他帝国可启用项目 GAS_RESTORATION（费用2000，科学船+科学家），完成后 anomaly.6850“反转深度扫描极性”：每月社会研究加成与 d_society_6 矿藏，并把 gas_cascade_sad 改为 gas_cascade_happy（5年）。

Two results, 50% each. anomaly.300 "Atmospheric Ecosystem": d_society_3 deposit plus atmospheric_ecosystem (and flag atmoseco_divination_flag). anomaly.6845 "Cascading Catastrophe": deposits cleared; empires that do not value others may take a research bonus directly; unless both unfriendly and xenophobe, others can enable project GAS_RESTORATION (cost 2000, science ship and scientist), after which anomaly.6850 "Reversing Deep Scan Polarities" gives monthly society research and a d_society_6 deposit and turns gas_cascade_sad into gas_cascade_happy (5 years).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

两个起始结果互斥；6845 的选项（直接奖励或启用项目）按 values_others 与友善/排外状态决定。

The two starting results are exclusive; 6845's options (direct reward or the project) depend on values_others and the unfriendly/xenophobe status.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

anomaly.6845 / 6850 的描述与选项按 values_others 变化。

anomaly.6845 / 6850 descriptions and options vary with values_others.
